scope: small DeepSWE pilot; first one task with both systems

budget_per_task_per_system.token_accounting_definition: Count canonical text messages, function calls/results, instructions and tool schemas once across replayed history. New generated message occurrences count even if identical. Do not deduplicate words or overlapping code across different messages.
budget_per_task_per_system.actual_usage_reporting: Record summed provider input/output tokens separately; no processed-token threshold in this contract.
budget_per_task_per_system.token_overshoot: A completed message or response can cross the content threshold; record actual overshoot and stop following work.

next_step: Use the new accounting on the first development task; review outcomes before the other four tasks.
